text: Supervised learning trains a model on labelled examples, so that it can predict the correct label for new inputs it has not seen before.
Overfitting happens when a model memorises its training data and then performs poorly on new data. Regularisation and cross-validation help to prevent it.
A neural network is made of layers of connected units. Backpropagation and gradient descent adjust the weights of the connections to reduce the prediction error.
Large language models are trained on huge amounts of text to predict the next token, and can then answer questions, write text and summarise documents.
A Python list comprehension builds a new list from an existing iterable in a single line, for example [x * x for x in range(10)].
A Python virtual environment keeps the packages installed for one project separate from other projects, so each project can use its own library versions.
When an error occurs at runtime, Python raises an exception. A try/except block catches the exception so that the program can recover instead of stopping.
A relational database stores data in tables made of rows and columns. SQL queries join related tables through primary keys and foreign keys.
An index on a database column speeds up lookups, much like the index at the back of a book, at the cost of extra storage and slower writes.
A database transaction groups several changes so that either all of them are saved or none are. The ACID properties keep the data consistent after a failure.
Cloud providers rent out virtual machines and storage on demand, so a company pays only for the computing capacity it actually uses.
Serverless functions run code in response to events, such as an HTTP request or a new file, without the developer managing servers. The platform scales them automatically.
Containers package an application together with its dependencies. Kubernetes schedules and scales containers across a cluster of machines.
Phishing emails pretend to come from a trusted sender in order to trick people into revealing their passwords or clicking malicious links.
SQL injection attacks insert malicious code into a database query through unvalidated user input. Parameterised queries prevent them.
Multi-factor authentication asks for a second proof of identity, such as a one-time code sent to a phone, in addition to the password.
Ransomware encrypts the files on a victim's computer and demands a payment for the decryption key. Offline backups limit the damage.
Compound interest is earned on both the original deposit and the interest already added, so savings grow faster the longer they are left untouched.
Diversification spreads investments across different kinds of assets, so a loss in one holding has a smaller effect on the whole portfolio.
Banks use machine learning models to flag unusual card transactions that may be fraudulent and to block them before money is lost.
